messages:
pat: Noticed unusual p99 inflation in the merged endpoint tile for /v1/complete at ~09:03. p50/p95 look normal.
kevin: I saw that. When I split by region/backend the spike disappears. Merged rollup seems to be the culprit.
sara: likely duplicate samples (retries or fanout) being counted multiple times when we tdigest-merge. That pushes the upper tail.
jonas: quick check: raw samples show repeated request_id with different replica/retry flags. If we dedupe by request_id before aggregation p99 drops back to expected.
pat: example ad-hoc: `p99 raw=1.04s`, `p99 deduped_by_request=0.18s`. Huge gap.
kevin: API design question: add `dedupe_by` param + `aggregation_mode` to the metrics API, or perform ingestion-side dedupe? My vote: query-time transform is safer (keeps raw immutable).
jonas: agree. Ingest-level dedupe rewrites history and surprises customers. Query-time dedupe with defaults in Console is reversible.
sara: UX idea: add a small "provenance" pill on the latency tile showing the transform chain, e.g. "merged • dedupe=request_id • tdigest". Hover shows exact query params and a link to run raw vs deduped comparison.
pat: perf note: I ran a micro-bench on a 200k-sample window: grouping by request_id adds ~10% CPU and ~85-120ms latency. Added benchmark to the PR.
kevin: tests: need synthetic harness that injects duplicated slow samples and asserts p99 collapses when dedupe is enabled. Also define deterministic tie-breaker (choose min latency per request_id) so SLOs don't accidentally inflate.
jonas: will add merge-path unit tests and a regression harness. Also propose a delta-report endpoint that returns raw vs deduped percentiles so tenant admins can preview impact.
sara: Console: default merged endpoint tiles to show deduped series but include a "show raw" toggle. Also add a per-tenant setting to override defaults. Display a small banner when dedupe changes numbers >5%.
console-bot: staging deploy: telemetry service at 1765554800 (canary group running dedupe=false by default).
pat: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/2060 adds `dedupe_by` + provenance header and Console flag. PTAL.
kevin: nit: include perf numbers in the API docs and a recommended threshold for when to enable dedupe in dashboards (e.g., merged endpoints only).
jonas: noted. Let's land API param default off, Console opt-in for merged tiles, run a week-long canary for delta reports, then refine defaults.
pat: thanks — I'll iterate on PR and schedule the canary.
